text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home after going shopping with 
Lucky Lilac—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Huh, tickets for a hot spring trip? That's 
quite a lavish lottery prize.
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, I think I got a 
lottery ticket.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh? In that case, would you like to draw 
one to test your luck?
choice_data_list: Maybe you'll win if you draw, Luck.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Just because you're Lucky Lilac. ...Hah, 
shut up."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Still, well, it's a good opportunity. 
Shall we try spinning it together?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Let's treat this as a test of our luck 
together from here on."
choice_data_list: Alright, let's give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Lucky Lilac, I spun the 
raffle wheel's crank!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Y-You're kiddin' me~~~~~~~?!?! Did I 
really actually win...?!)
choice_data_list: You did it!
You did it!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Unbelievably enough, it really turned 
out to be a lucky lilac.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Still, what should I do with this? I 
never thought I'd actually win, so I 
haven't thought about how to spend it at 
all—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...Or rather...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, so this means I'm going with 
Trainer, right?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I'd really love to go, but... I wonder 
what Trainer thinks. Would it be a 
bother...?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(No, but we did draw it as a pair... 
Though it's not like we talked about what 
to do about the hot springs...â)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(—Ah, geez! No use overthinking it! Just 
gotta go for it with that in mind!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—For now, let's use it once things settle 
down and we can take our time.
choice_data_list: Yeah, that seems like a good idea.
Yeah, that seems like a good idea!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Alright.
choice_data_list: Luck?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ah, no. It's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, Trainer, could you hold onto 
the travel vouchers for me?
choice_data_list: Okay, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Then let's look forward to that time, 
yeah?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Oh! We got a good one!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what a magnificent dish. It feels 
almost like a waste to just eat it plain 
like this.
choice_data_list:
Indeed... I'd love to set out some side 
dishes too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah, then since we're here, why don't we go 
buy some ingredients and cook something 
after this?
choice_data_list: Sounds good! Let's do it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we ended up borrowing a corner 
of the academy cafeteria's kitchen—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll make the marinade, so 
Trainer, please take care of the soup and 
salad.
choice_data_list: Leave it to me! Are 10 stockpots enough?
Leave it to me! Are 10 stockpots enough?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
How much food are you even plannin' to 
make?! Even an Umamusume couldn't eat that 
much!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, we cooked together while 
sharing silly, casual chats with Lucky 
Lilac, enjoying a wonderful time—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Oh my...! I won something.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"W-Well, you said it was a mountain of 
food so I wondered what to expect, but 
this is way more than I imagined..."
choice_data_list:
It might be a bit tough for just us to 
finish it all off.

It might be a bit much for just us to 
finish it all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...If that's the case, would it be alright 
if I took some?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Since I had the opportunity, I thought I'd 
use this to express my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. And that's why you baked it into 
a carrot cake and brought it to me.”

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Everyone has taken such good care of 
me, so...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I shall enjoy it, 
then.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huh, I like that it isn't too sweet. I'll 
gladly accept it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I smell a huge wave coming...! A collab 
with Golshi-chan brand fried 
noodles—this'll conquer the world, I tell 
ya...!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you very much, even including me, 
Officer Fenomeno...! I shall savor every 
bite!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I really should drop by more often~. This 
cake is delicious. Thanks, Lala.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Your spirit in serving me is commendable. 
Continue to strive diligently.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Look, Orfe is happy too~.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...You.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'm relieved to see it suited 
everyone's tastes.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Thank goodness~~~~!! And man, I'm so 
freakin' happy~~~~!!)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Well, this should be just about 
right, don't ya think?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Still, a single carrot... It's 
surprisingly tricky to figure out the best 
way to use it.
choice_data_list:
Maybe I'll make them into carrot sticks or 
something.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah, that's right. Kind of like a 
light snack.
choice_data_list:
And maybe watch something while snacking 
on it...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds fun. Well then, shall we 
watch something in the Trainer's office?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Lucky Lilac and I ended up 
watching a comedy show together in the 
trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...! This duo has some serious 
momentum behind their comebacks, don't 
they?
choice_data_list: Yeah, about a tenth of it is pure luck.
Yeah, it's about a tenth of what Luck has.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Man, just how hard was that retort?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, while munching on carrot sticks, 
they spent a wonderful time together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(N-Now that I actually missed, it really 
bums me out...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
W-Well... times like this happen too, 
right?
choice_data_list:
I suppose............ you're 
right............

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, aren't you the one who's completely 
bummed out?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped. Let's just go home 
quietly.
choice_data_list: Right...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, feeling a little dejected, the two 
of them returned to the academy...
